suites.summary: MCP Tier 0 and Tier 1 against a disposable local stack.
MCP Tier 0 on production (mcp:accept:protocol) and the watcher.
MCP Tier 1 on production: claude-code, claude-ai, anthropic-api, openai-api, inspector.
MCP Tier 2: ChatGPT web and Claude web in the Cadence QA Chrome profile.
QA Calendar create, list and delete for test account A.
QA Calendar create, list and delete for test account B.
Ticket 284-style web travel acceptance in QA Chrome as test account A.
Google, Outlook and iCloud Calendar and Hevy connection checks for test account A.
Dev-signed build, install and installed checks on the owner's Mac.
Installed checks on the test Mac over Tailscale SSH as test account A.
Sequenzy reminder test send to the AgentMail test inbox.
Hosted Supabase migration list and pushes that docs/DECISIONS.md, 2026-11-10, approves in advance.
